description: Stadt Neuss: Trinkbrunnen is a dataset listed in Open Data im Rhein-Kreis Neuss, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Stadt Neuss. Für das Projekt "Kühle Karte Neuss" des Amtes für Klima und Umwelt der Stadt Neuss (Amt 19) werden hier die öffentlichen Trinkbrunnen als Geometriedaten veröffentlicht und zur Nutzung freigegeben. Coverage: Rhein-Kreis Neuss. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are Stadt Neuss, Trinkwasser, KühleKarte, Wasser. The portal shows 7 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons CC Zero License (cc-zero) (http://dcat-ap.de/def/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-rhein-kreis-neuss-de-portal.
